items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: We would meet at Bud Yorkin, and Norman Lear, you know, we would meet at the office... We were at the Tandem Enterprises. that's Bud Yorkin and Norman Lear, you know? We met there about 11:00 o'clock on a Friday night

ctx.x: Yeah, well Duke told me he wanted you over there to look out for his musical interests.

Yes, I know that. And I think Quincy realized that. We would meet at Bud Yorkin, and Norman Lear, you know, we would meet at the office and look at the small screen showings of Duke and whatever, and -- but that was before the rest of the writers came in. But my job was just to be a communicator.
